# gst

Assessing sample size and power, and presenting consolidated evidence

## Description

The {gst} package provides a toolbox for assessing sample size and power
for Global Statistical Tests across a variety of scenarios, and
presenting consolidated evidence using a forest plot.

## Installation

The package is not yet available on CRAN. To install the development
version of the package from Github run:

    pak::pak("Sarepta-Therapeutics/gst")

## Shiny Apps

The {gst} package includes two shiny applications. For details on how to
use the apps, please review the vignettes.

### GST Power App

``` r
library(gst)
gst_power_app()
```

### Make Forestplot App

``` r
library(gst)
make_forestplot_app()
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`alert_icon()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/alert_icon.md)
  : Alert icon
- [`app_sys()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/app_sys.md)
  : Access files in the current app
- [`cor_cs()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/cor_cs.md)
  : Create a compound-symmetric correlation matrix
- [`data_as_code()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/data_as_code.md)
  : Convert data.frame to R code that creates identical dataset
- [`esWidgetServer()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/esWidgetServer.md)
  : Sidebar Effect Size Server
- [`esWidgetUI()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/esWidgetUI.md)
  : Sidebar Effect Size UI
- [`forest_data()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/forest_data.md)
  : Forestplot Example Data
- [`forest_import_csv()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/forest_import_csv.md)
  : Import forest plot data from csv file
- [`forest_plot()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/forest_plot.md)
  : Draw forest plot
- [`forest_reprex()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/forest_reprex.md)
  : Create reproducible code for current forestplot
- [`forest_suggest_params()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/forest_suggest_params.md)
  : Suggest parameters for a forest_plot
- [`get_n()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/get_n.md)
  : Calculate sample size
- [`get_oes()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/get_oes.md)
  : Calculate operational effect size
- [`get_power()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/get_power.md)
  : Calculate Power
- [`gstTippingPoint_ui()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/gstTippingPoint_ui.md)
  : Effect size tipping point calculation
- [`gst_power_app()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/gst_power_app.md)
  : Launch the GST Power App
- [`info_icon()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/info_icon.md)
  : Info icon
- [`make_forestplot_app()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/make_forestplot_app.md)
  : A Shiny app to make a forest plot
- [`obrien()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/obrien.md)
  : O’Brien test
- [`obrien_plus()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/obrien_plus.md)
  : O'Brien Plus: Analytical Power for Joint AND Any Individual Endpoint
- [`obt()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/obt.md)
  : Perform Obrien truncated closed testing
- [`p_combine()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/p_combine.md)
  : P-value combination method
- [`power2_sever()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/power2_sever.md)
  : OLS Power Server
- [`power2_ui()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/power2_ui.md)
  : OLS Power UI
- [`rmnv()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/rmnv.md)
  : Simulate from a Multivariate Normal Distribution
- [`sartheme()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/sartheme.md)
  : Sarepta theming function (ported over from Sarappta)
- [`sim_power()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/sim_power.md)
  : Calculate Power by simulation
- [`tooltip_label()`](https://sarepta-therapeutics.github.io/gst/reference/tooltip_label.md)
  : Custom label with optional tooltip icons
